summary: Rules every GT-BIBLE strategy shares: the Bible's trend + level + signal method, timeframes, as-of higher-timeframe context, level definitions, entry/stop/target arithmetic, the 2:1 floor and the one-direction portfolio policy.

source_document.title: The Candlestick Trading Bible
source_document.page_convention: printed page number = PDF page number (verified 2026-10-14 by OCR of all 169 pages; page 116 and 169 carry no text)

evidence_labels.SOURCE_EXPLICIT: the Bible states it in words on the cited page
evidence_labels.SOURCE_CHART: shown in a Bible chart or diagram on the cited page, not stated in words
evidence_labels.INTERP: a GoldThinker numerical or procedural choice where the Bible gives no number; listed under interpretations with an id
evidence_labels.EXISTING_SPEC: an already-frozen GoldThinker definition (CANDLE_SPEC_V1 / D-095 / D-097 / D-121) reused unchanged; also an interpretation

method.rule: A trade exists only when the market type, a level and one of the four Bible signals agree, in the market's direction, with at least 2:1 room to the next level.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: These three aspects which are the trend, the level, and the signal are what we will use in our trading approach

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if it is a choppy market, you close your chart and you stay away.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Wait for a pin bar, an engulfing bar, an inside bar, or an inside bar false breakout to form near these levels in line with the direction of the market, and then execute your trade.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: we are not going to take any pin bar that we find on our chart.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: this rejection doesn't indicate a reversal signal, because this price action setup can form everywhere in your chart.

price_basis.execution: BUY fills at ASK, SELL fills at BID; exits: long at BID, short at ASK
price_basis.historical_bid_only_note: On bid-only history the ASK is not observed. A run must label any ASK-dependent number MODELLED with its spread assumption, or report directional price research only. Never invent intraminute ordering.
price_basis.label: EXISTING_SPEC

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: As a price action trader, your primary time frame is the 1H, the 4H and the daily.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if you try to trade pin bars or engulfing bars on the 5-minute time frame, you will lose your money

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The pin bar formed in bigger time frames such as the 4 hour or daily time frame should be taken into consideration

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if you are beginner i recommend you to stick with trading this signal in bigger time frames such the daily and the 4-hour time frame.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: we will use the 21 and the 8-simple moving averages in the daily and 4-hour time frames

higher_timeframe.as_of_rule: A higher-timeframe candle is usable only if its full period ended at or before the signal candle's completion. The forming higher-timeframe candle is never used.
higher_timeframe.agree_rule_trend_strategies: Every timeframe in alignment_map[signal_tf] must have market_state TREND_UP for a BULL trade or TREND_DOWN for a BEAR trade.
higher_timeframe.agree_rule_range_strategies: No timeframe in alignment_map[signal_tf] may be CHOP, UNDETERMINED, or a TREND opposite to the trade side; TREND in the trade's side or RANGE_BOUNDED is allowed.
higher_timeframe.missing_context: If a required higher-timeframe series has too few completed candles to compute market_state (ATR14 needs 15; G3 needs 2 swing highs and 2 swing lows in its 200-bar window), the decision is NO_TRADE with reason HTF_UNAVAILABLE. A missing trend is never read as up or down.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: To determine whether a market is trending or not, you have to use bigger time frames such the 4H, the daily or the weekly time frame. Never try to use smaller time frames to determine the market structure.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if the weekly and the daily charts analysis align with the 4h chart, you can then take your trading decision.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if you want to trade the 1H chart, you have to look at the daily chart first.

sources.label: SOURCE_CHART
sources.quote: Elements from the higher time frames can be such a power feature, that they dominate over signal on your trading time frame. [text printed inside the p.74 chart image]

market_state.engine: goldthinker.core.book_levels.market_state(bars, cutoff, atr, trend, low, high) with trend = goldthinker.core.structure.trend_from_swings(swings(bars, cutoff), atr)
market_state.atr: goldthinker.core.indicators.atr14(bars, i0): simple mean of the 14 true ranges of the completed bars ending at i0-1
market_state.cutoff: For the signal timeframe: the bar BEFORE the formation's first bar (the formation never defines its own context). For a higher timeframe: its last completed bar per the as_of_rule.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Trending markets are simply characterized by a repeating pattern of higher highs and higher low in an up-trending market, and lower high and lower low in a down trending market.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: To confirm a ranging market, i have to look for at least two touches of support level, and two touches of resistance level

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if you feel like you can't identify the boundaries (support and resistance). this is a clear indication of a choppy market.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: This is a sign of a choppy market that you should stay away from.

market_state.label: EXISTING_SPEC

levels.role_rule: A BULL trade needs a level acting as SUPPORT at the formation's lowest low; a BEAR trade a level acting as RESISTANCE at the formation's highest high.
levels.tolerance: within AT_ZONE * ATR = 0.10 * ATR of the level's [lo, hi] (distance 0 inside)

ZONE.definition: a LIVE G4 zone (goldthinker.core.book_levels.zones_detail) on the signal timeframe whose role is SUPPORT (bull) / RESISTANCE (bear)
ZONE.label: EXISTING_SPEC

FLIP.definition: an INTACT flipped level (goldthinker.core.book_levels.flipped_levels) whose potential_role is SUPPORT (bull) / RESISTANCE (bear); at_flip()
FLIP.label: EXISTING_SPEC

FIB_50_618.definition: book_levels.fib_facts(side).in_50_618_zone is true (last confirmed impulse by G3 swings)
FIB_50_618.label: EXISTING_SPEC

SD_ZONE.definition: a fresh supply (bear) / demand (bull) zone on the signal timeframe or a higher timeframe containing the extreme +-0.10*ATR (goldthinker.core.sd_zones.at_zone)
SD_ZONE.label: EXISTING_SPEC

HTF_ZONE.definition: a LIVE role-matched G4 zone of any timeframe in alignment_map[signal_tf], computed on that timeframe's own bars and ATR, containing the extreme +- 0.10 * that timeframe's ATR
HTF_ZONE.label: INTERP

RANGE_BOUNDARY.definition: book_levels.market_state position AT_LOWER (bull) / AT_UPPER (bear) on the signal timeframe
RANGE_BOUNDARY.label: EXISTING_SPEC

confluence_sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
confluence_sources.quote: If you can find just one or two factors of confluence that come up together with a good pin bar setup, this is quite enough to make a profitable trade.

confluence_sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
confluence_sources.quote: make sure that your signal is located in a key level in the market.

levels.record: Every decision records every level kind that matched (level_sources) so results can be split by level kind.

stop.buffer: G_BUFFER = max(0.20 USD, 0.05 * ATR), then quantised to the tick (G13)
stop.rule: BULL: stop = anchor_low - G_BUFFER; BEAR: stop = anchor_high + G_BUFFER. Each strategy names its anchor.
stop.hard_stop: Sent with the order; never moved.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Don't never think of using mental stops

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: your stop loss above the long tail.

target.rule: NEXT_LEVEL: the nearest level strictly beyond the entry in the trade direction among (a) live G4 zones of the signal timeframe, (b) INTACT flipped levels of the signal timeframe, (c) live G4 zones of every alignment timeframe. Target price = that level's near edge (BUY: lo; SELL: hi), quantised. The rule never steps over a nearer obstacle.
target.straddle: A level that contains or straddles the entry is the nearest obstacle: TARGET_ALREADY_PASSED, no trade (CANDLE_SPEC ruling A-04).
target.none: No level beyond the entry: NO_TARGET, no trade.
target.range_override: Range strategies use the opposite boundary's near edge instead (see each manifest).
target.frozen_at: computed once from levels known at the signal candle's completion and stored on the trade

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: your profit target will be the next support level in case of a downtrend.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: look at simply the chart to find the next support or resistance level, this is going to be your profit target.

reward_to_risk.formula: rr = |target - entry| / |entry - stop| using the order's entry price (market: the executable fill price; limit/stop orders: the order price)
reward_to_risk.below_minimum: RR_BELOW_2: no trade (recorded with the computed rr)
reward_to_risk.costs: The floor is applied to price distances (the Bible speaks of money won vs risked and never mentions costs). Reports must also give the net-of-cost figure.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Price action signals with low risk /reward ratios should be ignored.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: just make sure your trade has a potential of 2:1 risk to reward ratio.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Don't never enter a trade in which the profit is less than the amount of money you risked. If you will risk 100$ for example, your profit target should be at least 200$ [OCR of the PDF reads 2008; the image shows 200$]

trade_life.exit: Only the stop or the target. No time exit, no trailing, no break-even move.
trade_life.data_end: A trade still open at the end of the data is CENSORED, never closed at a price.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Place your stop loss order. And your profit target. And forget about your trade.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: When you set your protective stop and your target, don't never look back

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: If you are beginner, don't risk more than 1%.

portfolio_policy.direction_gate: A trade may only be taken in the direction its market_state and alignment allow (see each manifest).
portfolio_policy.no_oppose: NO_OPPOSE: a new GoldThinker trade is refused while any GoldThinker position in the opposite direction is open (D-170 arm, here the rule). Reason OPPOSITE_POSITION_OPEN.
portfolio_policy.same_direction_stacking: Allowed: a new same-direction trade at a new signal is permitted (B p.102, 141, 161 show repeated with-trend entries).
portfolio_policy.one_per_cluster: One trade per signal cluster (timeframe, side, signal candle). If several GT-BIBLE strategies fire on the same candle and side, the first in priority_order is taken; the others are recorded DUPLICATE_CLUSTER.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if it is a bullish market, you will look for a buying opportunity, because you have to trade with the trend, and if the market is bearish, you have to look for a selling opportunity.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: you will only look for selling opportunities, this way, you are not fighting big institutions and central banks

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: This trading method will give you confidence in your trading approach and it will allow you to avoid over-trading.

decision_reasons.TRADE: all gates pass; an order is produced
decision_reasons.RECORD_ONLY: all gates pass for a strategy whose execution_class is RECORD_ONLY
decision_reasons.TF_NOT_ALLOWED: signal timeframe not in the manifest's list
decision_reasons.OWN_STATE: signal-timeframe market_state not allowed for this side
decision_reasons.HTF_UNAVAILABLE: a required higher-timeframe state cannot be computed
decision_reasons.HTF_DISAGREE: a required higher-timeframe state does not agree
decision_reasons.NO_LEVEL: no allowed level kind at the formation's extreme
decision_reasons.NOT_AT_BOUNDARY: range strategy: formation not at the side's boundary
decision_reasons.TARGET_ALREADY_PASSED: the nearest level contains or is behind the entry
decision_reasons.PENDING_BREAKOUT: inside bar: waiting for the window to resolve (not terminal)
decision_reasons.NO_SWEEP: inside bar false breakout: no single-bar sweep and reclaim within the window
decision_reasons.SWEEP_BOTH_SIDES: the sweep bar pierced both sides of the mother
decision_reasons.SWEEP_WRONG_SIDE: the sweep is on the other side than this strategy's

interpretations.choice: G3: a swing high/low needs 2 lower highs / higher lows on each side; trend = last two swing highs AND lows both higher by >= 0.10*ATR (UP) or both lower (DOWN), else RANGE; fewer than 2 of either = UNDETERMINED; 200-bar window

interpretations.label: EXISTING_SPEC

interpretations.choice: book_levels.market_state: RANGE_BOUNDED = G3 RANGE with a live zone with >= 2 separate swing-low touches below the reference close and one with >= 2 swing-high touches above it, not overlapping; else CHOP
interpretations.bible: at least two touches each side (p.103); chop = can't identify boundaries (p.68)
interpretations.label: EXISTING_SPEC

interpretations.choice: extreme within 0.10*ATR of the level

interpretations.label: EXISTING_SPEC

interpretations.choice: G4: swing pivots clustered within 0.25*ATR, at least 2 pivots with a pair >= 3 bars apart, zone = median +- 0.125*ATR, role = type of the latest pivot, dies on a close beyond it by > 0.10*ATR
interpretations.bible: swing points act as support/resistance (p.58-59)
interpretations.label: EXISTING_SPEC
